integrity: Derived from strict convexity, an exact inversion symmetry, and verified Fourier moments. Standalone high-precision numerical tests are supplementary rather than proof of the continuum claim.
scientific_limitations: For real 0<r<1 and the specified rank-one operator only. Exact coefficient and symbol do not compute all operators on the model space. Elliptic formula uses the parameter convention. Earlier differently phrased extremals may be unindexed; no independent audit.
title: Exact Poisson-weighted \(L^1\) approximation and least bounded symbols in a quadratic model space
